name: Do I need framing work for my remodel, or is it only for major projects?

mainEntity.name: Do I need framing work for my remodel, or is it only for major projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: You usually need a framing contractor when your remodel changes wall locations, enlarges or adds doorways, opens up rooms, modifies ceiling lines, or affects load-bearing structure. If the project is only cosmetic, framing may not be needed, but any structural change should be evaluated before demolition starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: If your remodel moves walls, changes openings, or affects load-bearing areas, framing is usually required. Cosmetic updates alone often do not need it, but structural changes should be checked before work begins.
